sn17.5:1.3: seyyathāpi bhikkhave kaṃsaḷakā gūthādī gūthapūrā puṇṇā gūthassa pūrato cassa mahāgūthapuñjo
sn17.5:1.5: ahamhi gūthādī gūthapūrā puṇṇā gūthassa pūrato ca myāyaṃ mahāgūthapuñjoti.
sn17.5:1.6: evameva kho bhikkhave idhekacco bhikkhu lābhasakkārasilokenābhibhūto pariyādinnacitto pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā piṇḍāya pavisati
sn17.5:1.7: so tattha bhuttāvī ca hoti yāvadattho nimantito ca svātanāya piṇḍapātopassa pūro
sn17.5:1.8: so ārāmaṃ gantvā bhikkhugaṇassa majjheva vikatheti
sn17.5:1.9: bhuttāvī camhi yāvadattho nimantito camhi svātanāya piṇḍapāto ca myāyaṃ pūro lābhī camhi cīvara piṇḍapāta senāsana- gilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhārānaṃ ime pana aññe bhikkhū appa puññā appesakkhā na lābhino cīvara piṇḍapāta senāsanagilānapaccaya- bhesajjaparikkhārānanti.
sn17.5:1.10: so tena lābhasakkārasilokena abhibhūto pariyādinnacitto aññe pesale bhikkhū atimaññati.
sn17.5:1.11: tañhi tassa bhikkhave moghapurisassa hoti dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāya.
